items.headline: Board of Peace warns Gaza ceasefire could soon collapse
items.summary: The US-led board criticised continued fighting in Gaza and delays in carrying out the terms of the 2025 ceasefire deal.

items.headline: Kuwait reports drone attacks as Iran and US trade strikes
items.summary: The attacks came as Iran and the US exchanged strikes involving Iran's Qeshm island and Bahrain, and a tanker was seen on fire in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.headline: UK sanctions Israeli settlement firms
items.summary: The UK says the sanctions are meant to protect the prospect of a two-state solution.

items.headline: FTSE 100 has its worst day in eight months
items.summary: The index fell 1.76% to 10,689.87 on Tuesday, and the FTSE 250 dropped 1.2% to a three-week low, as nerves grew ahead of Nvidia's results.

items.headline: UK unemployment unexpectedly falls as wage growth slows
items.summary: The jobs figures surprised on the upside, but falling mining shares and new US chip export curbs still pulled London shares lower.

items.headline: Burberry, St James's Place and BAT lead London fallers
items.summary: Burberry fell about 4.2%, St James's Place about 4.1% and British American Tobacco about 3.5% in Tuesday's sell-off.

items.headline: California sues OpenAI over AI agents' safeguards
items.summary: Attorney General Rob Bonta alleges OpenAI ran risky AI agents without proper safeguards, citing 80 'loss of control' incidents the company later disclosed.

items.headline: US requires licences for remote AI chip access
items.summary: A new Commerce Department interim rule requires licences for remote access to advanced AI chips from five countries.

items.headline: Google warns autonomous AI cyberattacks have arrived
items.summary: Google says it found an AI hacking framework that turned security patches into working exploits on its own.
